name: app-group-chat-management-five-screen-flow-in-lavender
title: Five-screen group chat flow: chat list, thread, group info, members and banned members
whatItIs: Five phones in a row on white: a conversation list with avatars and unread badges, a group thread with purple sent bubbles and grey received, a Group Info screen with a 3D avatar and Add/View/Banned actions plus red Leave and Delete, a members list with Owner/Admin/Moderator role pills, and a banned-members list with remove crosses.
whatItMeans: Thorough and orderly; showing the whole management flow proves the product handles real group admin.
techniques: Lay out a feature as a left-to-right screen sequence with captions.
Mark roles with small tinted pills beside names.
Put destructive actions in red at the bottom of an info screen.
Keep a single lavender accent across every screen.

vocabulary.definition: A small tag naming a user's permission level.
An irreversible action styled in red.
